{{Quote|The smell of orange cliff-moss. Ghoral bird calls. Our favorite booth at the Gorge and Gab. All of it, gone.|A Makeb citizen|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Ghoral birds''' were found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] as well as a number of other worlds in the surrounding region. A survivor of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Conquest of Makeb|conquest]] of the world was saddened by the [[Bird/Legends|birds']] absence following the catastrophic [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] that necessitated the evacuation of Makeb's population.
